title.en: Amending Section Eighteen of Republic Act Numbered Fifty-One Hundred and Eighty-Five to Place City Works Supervisors Directly Under the Supervision of City Engineers

text.en:
The provision of Section 18 of Republic Act No. 5185 to the contrary notwithstanding, the City
Public Works Supervisor shall be under the direct supervision of the City Engineer.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
